rules.label: Collings electric prefix, production-start year, and category sequence

warnings: Collings electric serials identify a general series or model designation, production-start year, and category sequence from the official FAQ.
Collings says electric production-start year is not necessarily the ship year.
Collings says acoustic exact ship-date information requires contacting Collings with the serial number.
Serial lookup does not authenticate an instrument, identify its exact model, or establish value.
